```{r Load Qi data}
input_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

replicate_cells <- which(seurat_obj$orig.ident == biorep_id) %>% names
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = replicate_cells)

assay <- params$assay
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- assay

    seurat_obj[[assay]] <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
      seurat_obj[[assay]], layers = "counts", new = "counts"
    )
  }
}
```

Pairwise transcriptomic similarity among discrete cell states

```{r Discrete stages hourlgass}
# # Use temporary group IDs because Seurat may replace underscores in names.
# state_ids <- setNames(sprintf("State%02d", seq_along(cluster_levels)), cluster_levels)

pb_discrete <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj,
  assays = assay,
  features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj),
  group.by = "cell_label",
  verbose = FALSE
)[[assay]]
similarity_discrete <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_discrete[, fusiform_lineage, drop = FALSE],
  pb_discrete[, ray_lineage, drop = FALSE],
  metrics = params$metric
)
p_similarity_discrete <- pheatmap(
  similarity_discrete,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  main = sprintf("Fusiform vs Ray lineage: %s\n(%s)", biorep_id, params$metric)
)
```

## Test hourglass along pseudotime

**The procedure:**

1.  Infer pseudotime along cell lineages using Slingshot based on PCA coordinates.

2.  Aggregate expression by pseudotime bins (by `n_bins`).

3.  Calculate pairwise similarity between bins across lineages (using `metric`).

4.  Align cell lineages by bins using a Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm. (using `window_size`)

5.  Calculate the `hourglass score` based on cell lineage alignment.

    Hourglass score is defined as follows:

    Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

    $$
    E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
    M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
    L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
    $$

    The hourglass score was then defined as

    $$
    H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
    $$

    A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

6.  Permutation for the null distribution of the hourglass score\

    (1) Shuffle ray pseudotimes within this biological replicate, keeping the fusiform query and XMC stages fixed\
    (2) Repeat Step 2-5\
    (3) Estimate permutation p-value

7.  Bootstrapping for the confidence interval of the hourglass score\

    (1) Re-sample cells with replacement\
    (2) Repeat Step 1-5\
    (3) Estimate bootstrap confidence interval

### 1. Pseudotime inference

Infer Pseudotime based on PCA coordinates

```{r Infer Pseudotime}
slingshot_res <- suppressWarnings(slingshot_manual(seurat_obj, lineage_cell_types))
pseudotime <- slingshot_res$pseudotime
branch_id <- slingshot_res$branch_id

head(pseudotime)
head(branch_id)
```

```{r Plot Pseudotime}
prob <- slingCurveWeights(slingshot_res$SlingshotDataSet, as.probs = TRUE)
seurat_obj$pseudotime_all <- rowSums(pseudotime * prob)
p_pt <- FeaturePlot(
    seurat_obj,
    features = "pseudotime_all",
    reduction = plot_reduction
  ) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    direction = -1,
    option = "magma"
  ) +
  theme_void(
  )
p_pt + theme(legend.position = "bottom") | p_cluster + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### 2. Bin expression by pseudotime

Expression was aggregated within equal-width pseudotime bins independently for each lineage.

Fusiform and ray bins were subsequently aligned using a constrained monotonic DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) path.

```{r Bin expression}
n_bins <- as.integer(params$n_bins)
res_L1 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj,
  pseudotime, 
  branch_id,
  lineage = 1, 
  n_bins = n_bins, 
  prefix = "Fusiform"
)
res_L2 <- bin_expression(
  seurat_obj, 
  pseudotime,
  branch_id, 
  lineage = 2, 
  n_bins = n_bins, 
  prefix = "Ray"
)
pb_L1 <- res_L1$Pseudobulk
pb_L2 <- res_L2$Pseudobulk
comp_L1 <- res_L1$Composition
comp_L2 <- res_L2$Composition

# Keep gap diagnostics in the report and workspace without changing CSV schemas.
bin_occupancy <- data.frame(
  bin = seq_len(n_bins),
  Fusiform = as.integer(rowSums(comp_L1)),
  Ray = as.integer(rowSums(comp_L2))
)
print(bin_occupancy)
```

### 3. Pairwise similarity of pseudotime bins

Calculate pairwise similarity among pseudotime bins based on the specified metric.

```{r Calculate similarity across binned pseudotime}
genes <- intersect(rownames(pb_L1), rownames(pb_L2))
genes <- intersect(genes, VariableFeatures(seurat_obj))
if (length(genes) < 2L) stop("Too few variable genes remained.")
similarity_L1 <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_L1[genes, , drop = FALSE],
  pb_L2[genes, , drop = FALSE],
  metrics = params$metric
)
```

Plot similarity

```{r Plot similarity}
pheatmap(
  similarity_L1,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  main = sprintf("Fusiform vs Ray lineage\n(%s)", params$metric)
)
```

### 4. Align pseudotime bins

Align pseudotime bins

```{r Run align_similarity_matrix}
aligned_L1 <- align_similarity_matrix(
  similarity_L1 %>% t,
  window_size = ceiling(
    as.numeric(params$window_dtw) * max(dim(similarity_L1))
  )
)
S_L1 <- aligned_L1$path$similarity
```

Plot aligned paths

```{r Plot DTW path}
plot_dtw_path <- function(
  similarity,
  aligned,
  title
) {
  similarity <- as.matrix(similarity)

  stopifnot(
    max(aligned$path$L1_i) <= nrow(similarity),
    max(aligned$path$L2_i) <= ncol(similarity)
  )

  heatmap_data <- expand.grid(
    L1_i = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
    L2_i = seq_len(ncol(similarity))
  )

  heatmap_data$similarity <- similarity[
    cbind(
      heatmap_data$L1_i,
      heatmap_data$L2_i
    )
  ]

  ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = L2_i,
      y = L1_i,
      fill = similarity
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_path(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "RdYlBu", 
      direction = -1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(ncol(similarity)),
      labels = colnames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_reverse(
      breaks = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
      labels = rownames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Fusiform reference bin (occupied bins only)",
      y = "Ray query bin",
      fill = "similarity",
      title = title
    )
}
p_path_L1 <- plot_dtw_path(
  similarity = similarity_L1 %>% t,
  aligned = aligned_L1,
  title = "Ray query Fusiform Ray reference DTW alignment\n(%s)" %>% sprintf(params$metric)
)

p_path_L1
```

```{r Plot simialrity along the alinged path}
    x = "Ray query pseudotime bin (ray middle stage shaded)",
    y = sprintf("Transcriptomic similarity (%s)", params$metric)
  )
p_aligned_similarity
```

### 5. Calculate hourglass score

Hourglass score is defined as follows:

Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

$$
E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
$$

The hourglass score was then defined as

$$
H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
$$

A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

```{r Calculate the hourglass score}
scores_observed <- as.data.frame(t(hourglass_score(S_L1, modules))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = "Fusiform-Ray", permutation = "Observed")
scores_observed
```

### 6. Permutation test

Permute pseudotime ordering along the ray lineage, repeat the previous procedure, and estimate the null distribution of the hourglass score.

```{r Permutation test, echo=TRUE, results='hide'}
# get params
n_permutation <- as.integer(params$n_permutation)
metric <- as.character(params$metric)

# logical for subseting ray lineage pseudotime
ray_keep <- as.character(seurat_obj$cell_label) %in% ray_lineage &
  is.finite(pseudotime[, 2])
ray_pt <- pseudotime[ray_keep, 2]

# get permutation seeds
set.seed(as.integer(params$seed))
permutation_seeds <- sample.int(
  n = .Machine$integer.max,
  size = n_permutation,
  replace = FALSE
)

# register paralelle backend
n_workers_perm <- get_n_workers(
  n_tasks = n_permutation,
  requested = params$n_parallel
)
message(
  "Running ", n_permutation, " permutations on ", n_workers_perm, " workers."
)
cl_perm <- parallel::makeCluster(
  n_workers_perm
)
registerDoSNOW(
  cl_perm
)

# create progress bar
perm_progress <- make_parallel_progress(
  n_permutation
)

# run permutation
scores_perm_list <- tryCatch(
  {
    foreach::foreach(
      i = seq_len(n_permutation),
      .inorder = FALSE,
      .options.snow = perm_progress$snow_options,
      .packages = c(
        "Seurat",
        "Matrix",
        "magrittr",
        "dtw",
        "sccore",
        "tibble"
      )
    ) %dopar% {
      source("notebooks/scripts/hourglass_analysis.R")

      # permute pseudotime
      pt_i <- pseudotime
      set.seed(permutation_seeds[i])
      pt_i[ray_keep, 2] <- sample(
        ray_pt,
        replace = FALSE
      )

      # Only the Ray pseudotime-to-expression association is shuffled.
      res_L2_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj, pt_i, branch_id, lineage = 2, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Ray"
      )
      pb_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Pseudobulk
      similarity_perm_i <- calculate_similarity(
        pb_L1[genes, , drop = FALSE], 
        pb_L2_i[genes, , drop = FALSE], 
        metrics = metric
      )
      aligned_perm_i <- align_similarity_matrix(
        similarity_perm_i %>% t,
        window_size = ceiling(
          as.numeric(params$window_dtw) * max(dim(similarity_perm_i))
        )
      )
      score_matrix <- t(hourglass_score(
        aligned_perm_i$path$similarity,
        modules
      ))

      # output
      data.frame(
        score_matrix,
        comparison = "Fusiform-Ray",
        permutation = sprintf(
          "Permutation-%d",
          i
        ),
        seed = permutation_seeds[i],
        row.names = NULL,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
  },
  finally = {
    close(perm_progress$pb)
    parallel::stopCluster(cl_perm)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }
)

scores_perm <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  scores_perm_list
)
```

Plot the null distribution of the hourglass score

```{r Plot the null distribution of the hourglass score}
p_scores_perm <- ggplot(scores_perm, aes(x = H)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  geom_vline(data = scores_observed, aes(xintercept = H), linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Permuted Fusiform-Ray hourglass score", y = "Number of permutations")
p_scores_perm
```

Calculate the permutation p-value

```{r Calculate the permutation p-value}
stopifnot(nrow(scores_perm) == n_permutation, all(is.finite(scores_perm$H)))
observed_H <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_obs = H
  )

permutation_results <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(H)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H_perm = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    observed_H,
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_obs = dplyr::first(H_obs),
    n_permutation = dplyr::n_distinct(permutation),
    n_null_ge_observed = sum(H_perm >= dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    null_mean = mean(H_perm),
    null_median = median(H_perm),
    null_sd = stats::sd(H_perm),
    null_q025 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.025)),
    null_q95 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.95)),
    null_q975 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.975)),
    observed_minus_null_mean = dplyr::first(H_obs) - mean(H_perm),
    observed_percentile = mean(H_perm < dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # One-sided empirical permutation P value
    p_empirical = (n_null_ge_observed + 1) / (n_permutation + 1),
    # Adjust p-value
    p_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_empirical, method = "holm")
  )

permutation_results
```

There is only one comparison, so no two-branch joint statistic is computed. The `p_holm` column is retained for schema compatibility and equals the unadjusted P-value within this replicate.

### 7. Bootstrapping

Re-sample cells with replacement, repeat the procedure for estimating the hourglass score, and calculate the confidence interval of the hourglass score.

```{r Define bootstrapping helper functions}
run_bootstrap_once <- function(seed) {
  on.exit(gc(), add = TRUE)
  tryCatch({
    # 1. Uniform within-replicate cell/spot bootstrap, retaining Qi's labels.
    seurat_obj_i <- make_bootstrap_seurat(seurat_obj, seed)$object
    
    # 2. Repeat preprocessing rather than freezing the original PCA/HVGs.
    seurat_obj_i <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
    seurat_obj_i <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
    seurat_obj_i <- ScaleData(
      seurat_obj_i, features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i), verbose = FALSE
    )
    seurat_obj_i <- RunPCA(seurat_obj_i, npcs = 10, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
    
    # 3. Refit the two manually specified lineages.
    slingshot_res_i <- suppressWarnings(slingshot_manual(seurat_obj_i, lineage_cell_types))
    
    # 4. Re-bin raw counts by the newly inferred pseudotimes.
    res_L1_i <- bin_expression(
      seurat_obj_i, 
      slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
      slingshot_res_i$branch_id,
      lineage = 1, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Fusiform"
    )
    res_L2_i <- bin_expression(
      seurat_obj_i, 
      slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
      slingshot_res_i$branch_id,
      lineage = 2, n_bins = n_bins, prefix = "Ray"
    )
    pb_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Pseudobulk
    pb_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Pseudobulk
    comp_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Composition
    comp_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Composition

    # 5. Re-identify middle-stage bins using the same fixed rule.
    modules_i <- get_middle_module(
      pb_L2_i, 
      ray_mid_markers$gene, 
      get_candidate_bins(comp_L2_i, c("XRP1", "XRP2"))
    )
    
    # 6. Use the bootstrap-specific variable genes, as in the template.
    genes_i <- intersect(rownames(pb_L1_i), rownames(pb_L2_i))
    genes_i <- intersect(genes_i, VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i))
    if (length(genes_i) < 2L) stop("Too few variable genes remained.")
    
    # 7-8. Recalculate similarity and re-estimate the DTW alignment.
    similarity_i <- calculate_similarity(
      pb_L1_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE], pb_L2_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
      metrics = metric
    )
    aligned_i <- align_similarity_matrix(
      similarity_i %>% t,
      ceiling(as.numeric(params$window_dtw) * max(dim(similarity_i)))
    )
    alignment_mass_i <- alignment_label_mass(
      aligned = aligned_i,
      comp_query = comp_L2_i, comp_reference = comp_L1_i,
      query_states = ray_lineage, reference_states = fusiform_lineage
    )
    
    # 9. Score the path using the FUSIFORM query bin IDs.
    scores <- data.frame(
      t(hourglass_score(
        aligned_i$path$similarity, modules_i
      )),
      comparison = "Fusiform-Ray", bootstrap = seed,
      row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE
    )
    list(
      ok = TRUE, seed = seed, scores = scores,
      alignment_mass = list(`Fusiform-Ray` = alignment_mass_i), error = NA_character_
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(ok = FALSE, seed = seed, scores = NULL,
         alignment_mass = NULL, error = conditionMessage(e))
  })
}
```

Check cell type alignment

```{r}
summarize_alignment_mass <- function(
    bootstrap_output,
    bootstrap_ok,
    comparison
) {
  mass_list <- lapply(
    bootstrap_output[bootstrap_ok],
    function(x) {
      x$alignment_mass[[comparison]]
    }
  )

  if (!length(mass_list)) return(NULL)
  mass_array <- array(
    unlist(mass_list, use.names = FALSE),
    dim = c(dim(mass_list[[1L]]), length(mass_list)),
    dimnames = c(dimnames(mass_list[[1L]]), list(NULL))
  )

  list(
    mean = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), mean),
    median = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), median),
    lower = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper = apply(mass_array,c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.975),
    array = mass_array
  )
}

# No two-branch summaries: this dataset has only Fusiform-Ray.
fusiform_alignment_summary <- summarize_alignment_mass(
  bootstrap_output, bootstrap_ok, comparison = "Fusiform-Ray"
)
if (!is.null(fusiform_alignment_summary)) {
  ray_given_fusiform <- sweep(
    fusiform_alignment_summary$mean, 1,
    rowSums(fusiform_alignment_summary$mean), "/"
  )
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    ray_given_fusiform, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f", border_color = NA,
    main = "Fusiform-Ray bootstrap alignment\nP(Ray state | Fusiform state)"
  )
}
```

Check for failed bootstraps

```{r Check for failed bootstraps}
if (any(!bootstrap_ok)) {
  bootstrap_errors <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      bootstrap_output[!bootstrap_ok],
      function(x) {
        data.frame(
          bootstrap = x$seed,
          error = x$error,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  )
} else {
  bootstrap_errors <- data.frame(
    bootstrap = integer(),
    error = character()
  )
}

message(
  sum(bootstrap_ok),
  " valid bootstrap replicates; ",
  sum(!bootstrap_ok),
  " failed replicates."
)

head(bootstrap_errors)
if (sum(bootstrap_ok) < 2L) {
  warning("Fewer than two valid bootstraps: confidence intervals will be NA.")
} else if (mean(bootstrap_ok) < 0.8) {
  warning("More than 20% of bootstraps failed; inspect bootstrap_errors before interpreting the CI.")
}
```

Calculate confidence interval

```{r Calculate confidence interval}
scores_observed_ci <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

scores_bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap_ci %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::n_distinct(bootstrap),

    H_median = median(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    H_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_E_median = median(M_minus_E, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_E_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_E_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_L_median = median(M_minus_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_L_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_L_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::right_join(
    scores_observed_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_observed = H,
        M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
        M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::coalesce(n_bootstrap, 0L),
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::matches("_ci_(lower|upper)$"),
      ~ ifelse(n_bootstrap >= 2L, .x, NA_real_)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_observed,
    H_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_E_ci_lower,
    M_minus_E_ci_upper,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    M_minus_L_ci_lower,
    M_minus_L_ci_upper,
    n_bootstrap
  )

bootstrap_ci
```
